messages:
Maya: Quick check — onboarding Zeta-14B weights. HF origin is `hf://redwood/zeta-14b/v1` and ops wants us to mirror to s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta/14b/v1 before serving. Can infra confirm perms and checksum flow?
Jordan: I can handle perms. Do we have a signed manifest from the model owner?
Maya: owner provided a manifest.json with sha256 for each shard. Pasted the top-level entries earlier in the task doc. We need mirror job + verify step.
Sam: FYI tokenizer had a small quirk on Zeta-13 where `bos_token` was missing in the hf config. We should validate tokenizer config before bake.
Nora: noted. I'll run tokenizer sanity after mirror. If `bos_token` missing we'll inject default and annotate in registry.
infra-bot: mirror-job-237 started by Jordan at 2026-03-17T11:12:10Z — copying 32 shards -> s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta/14b/v1/ ; presigned urls will expire in 7d.
Jordan: perms: I added s3:GetObject/list to the mirror role and restricted PutObject to our mirror bucket prefix. Also created registry entry `artifact:zeta-14b:v1` with read=eng,write=infra.
Maya: thanks. For checksum verification, prefer the pipeline run `sha256sum` and compare to manifest. If mismatch, fail and alert.
Sam: can we include a quick smoke run: load tokenizer, run `encode('hello world')` and validate decode roundtrip? That's how we caught the earlier bos issue.
Nora: yes — I'll add a small smoke script to the mirror job. snippet: ```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta/14b/v1/config.json ./ && python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('.'); print(t.encode('hello world'))"
```
Jordan: mirror reports 32/32 copied. infra-bot: mirror-job-237 completed, checksums queued.
infra-bot: checksum-check-237 passed (sha256 all match manifest).
Maya: awesome. Nora — can you run tokenizer smoke now and confirm bos/tokenizer config fields?
Nora: running... quick note: config.json has `added_tokens` field in a nested list that our loader ignores if not in top-level `vocab` path. I'll normalize that in registry metadata.
Sam: good catch. If we normalize, include original_config_sha in registry so we can trace.
Nora: done. Registry metadata updated: original_config_sha=sha256:fa12... , normalized=true.
Maya: Great. Final checklist: (1) mirror done + checksum pass, (2) tokenizer smoke + normalization, (3) registry entry with metadata and ACLs set, (4) deploy canary config to staging with `batch_size=8` and `max_seq=2048`. Jordan/Sam — can you own the canary deploy?
Jordan: I will trigger canary tomorrow morning, pinging #eng-oncall for watch.
Sam: I'll prepare the canary config and QA prompts. Also adding a quick eval to compare logits vs earlier V0 to spot regressions.
Maya: Perfect. Leave a short note in the issue when canary started. :thumbsup:
Jordan: will do.
Nora: all done on tokenizer side, leaving a short note in the artifact entry.
Maya: thanks team — closing this thread after canary starts.
